test_name: Verify Navigation Links Functionality Across the Header
description: This scenario ensures that all navigation links in the header (e.g., 'RoostGPT', 'Admin', 'Connectors') direct users to the correct pages and are accessible across different viewports.
steps: 2. Verify the presence and visibility of navigation links in the header.
3. Click on the 'RoostGPT' link and ensure it navigates to https://dev.roost.ai/roostgpt.
4. Verify the page title and URL to confirm successful navigation.
5. Click on the 'Admin' link and ensure it navigates to https://dev.roost.ai/admin/app.
6. Verify the page title and contents specific to the Admin page.
7. Click on the 'Connectors' link and ensure it navigates to https://dev.roost.ai/connectors.
8. Verify the Connectors page loads correctly with the expected content.
9. Return to https://dev.roost.ai/roostgpt/tests and confirm the current state is preserved.
10. Test each link on a mobile viewport (e.g., 375px width) to ensure accessibility.
expected_results: Navigation to each page is successful.
The expected content of each page is loaded correctly.
All links function on both desktop and mobile viewports.
edge_cases: Simulate slow network and test navigation behavior.
Test navigation links with JavaScript disabled.
Check behavior if a link's target page is unavailable (404 error).
Test navigation links in incognito mode.
Test with browser extensions that block JavaScript.
dependencies: Ensure the target pages ('RoostGPT', 'Admin', 'Connectors') are live and accessible.
Header navigation links are implemented correctly on the Test Plans page.
performance_metrics: Navigation response time (<2s for page load).
accessibility_requirements: WCAG 2.1: Verify that links have descriptive text for screen readers.
WCAG 2.1: Ensure focus indicators are visible for each link.
WCAG 2.1: Verify keyboard navigation to all links in the header.
